title: Luka Modric expected to return for World Cup after surgery on cheekbone fracture
content:
AC Milan and Croatia midfielder Luka Modric is set to miss the rest of the season but is expected to return in time for the World Cup after undergoing surgery on a cheekbone fracture.

Milan confirmed in a club statement on Monday that Modric, 40, had undergone successful surgery on a “complex, multi-fragment fracture” to his left cheek bone.
